pages.title: A Long Story
pages.text: Mill grain with an animal-powered Millstone and make Raw Noodles from dough.

pages.title: A Long Story
pages.text: Take animal-powered milling through to a kitchen ingredient.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A supported animal drives the mill; load grindable grain and collect flour. Native dough stretching or cutting produces noodles.

pages.title: Drive the stone mill
pages.text: A supported animal drives the Millstone. Valid grain becomes flour; moving pre-existing flour does not prove operating the mill.

pages.title: Make noodles
pages.text: Stretch dough by using it in hand or cut it on a board. This is ingredient preparation rather than buying a finished meal.
